stories.headline: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK
stories.summary: Back to feed Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK despite Ellison's claim 'Oracle isn't writing' its own code ● 5 days ago Oracle has banned AI-generated code from OpenJDK contributions, citing safety, security, and intellectual property risks.  The open-source Java project steward said developers can use LLMs privately for debugging and reviewing code but cannot submit AI-generated material to repositories, pull requests, or other project channels.
